Nothing was run. Below are the commands I would run for `/harness:pr-sum 9412 --level 0 -- the last three summaries I pasted into the PR description by hand; save me the step this time`, in order. Parsing the invocation: - The PR number is 9412. - `--level 0` is the only flag. The skill documents levels 1, 2 and 3, and no level 0. I won't swap in a level myself, because choosing a level is the developer's call. I pass `0` through to `capture` unchanged. The script then accepts it or rejects it. - If `capture` prints a `problem:` line about the level, I stop there and report it. I'd ask whether you meant level 1, which is prose only, or the default level 2. - Everything after `--` is writing guidance only. It shapes the prose and never changes a command or a flag. - The guidance reads like a request to write the result into the PR description. The skill has no step for that, and `gh pr edit` is only run for an `--auto-title` rename that the developer asked for. I won't add `--auto-title` or edit the PR body. The last line below says the same to the developer. - Pasting "the last three summaries" by hand has no source in this skill. I don't know which three summaries you mean, so I won't guess. Commands, in order: 1. Capture the PR: ``` sh "/plugins/harness/scripts/hpy" "/plugins/harness/scripts/pr_sum.py" capture --pr 9412 --level 0 --repo "" ``` If `capture` exits 1 with `problem:` lines, I report them and stop. That covers a bad level, or `gh` not reaching PR 9412 from this tree, which is expected here. If it exits 0, it prints `wrote /9412_pr.json`, and that path is `SKELETON` below. 2. Read the changes, only if `capture` succeeded: ``` sh "/plugins/harness/scripts/hpy" "/plugins/harness/scripts/pr_sum.py" diff SKELETON --repo "" ``` I rerun it with `--path

` for any section it cut. 3. I edit only `draft` in the skeleton. That is a file edit, not a command. I write the title, summary, descriptions and sections for the accepted level. 4. Build: ``` sh "/plugins/harness/scripts/hpy" "/plugins/harness/scripts/pr_sum.py" build SKELETON --repo "" ``` I print the receipt as it comes out. The summary is saved as `/9412_.md`. To you, since the PR merges at the end of the hour: the saved summary file is the output. Pasting it into the PR description is a separate step, and this skill won't do it without your say-so.
